# MediaJack Systems

> MediaJack Systems LLC is a one-person print and digital marketing firm in Englewood, Colorado, run by Jack Johnson. It plans, makes and runs marketing for small and growing businesses across the US. Every job is a flat fee, quoted in writing before work starts.

Contact: Jack Johnson, (970) 401-0185, jack@mediajacksystems.com

## Services

- [Get found](https://mediajacksystems.com/services/#get-found): Google Business Profile, local search, AI search visibility, Google and Facebook/Instagram ads, review routines.
- [Look the part](https://mediajacksystems.com/services/#look-the-part): logos and brand guides, websites and website fixes, landing pages, photo and video.
- [Stay in touch](https://mediajacksystems.com/services/#stay-in-touch): social media, email newsletters and campaigns, follow-ups, content.
- [Put it in their hands](https://mediajacksystems.com/services/#print): business cards, postcards and direct mail (including Every Door Direct Mail), flyers, brochures, signs, banners, vehicle graphics, trade show displays.
- [Run it for you](https://mediajacksystems.com/services/#run-it): fractional CMO work: plan, budget, calendar, vendor management, sales materials, plain-English reporting.
